message: ロロットントロ

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? Something's rustling under my foot...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Master Synn, you got a piece of trash stuck to your shoe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Must've been blown around by the sea breeze. Now, where's the trash can?」

name: Sally
message: 「W-W-Whoa there! Oopsie-daisy. My wrapper flew right off.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Master Synn, looks like Flatty came to stick herself to you too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, don't talk about Sally like she's trash.」

name: Sally
message: 「Bleh! I'm not taking you with us, Paqy!」
Huffing and puffing in a sulk, Sally neatly picks up her trash. Taking a closer look, what had caught on my shoe was the wrapper from a kids' snack.

name: Sally
message: 「Heya, Prez!」

name: Sally
message: 「C'mon, over here, over here! Lolo-chi is giving out as many stick candies as we want!」

name: Synn
message: 「...? What's Lolotte doing?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ewuu, another dud... It's a weird car, a MesserschmitTontoro...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're going all out here.」
In a corner of Tsukinoo Park, Lolotte sits surrounded by a mountain of candy toys, her shoulders slumped in utter defeat.
Beside her is a cardboard box with its flaps wide open. Having likely bought it in bulk, it's packed to the brim with stick candies that come with bonus toys.
Judging by the illustration on the packaging, they seem to contain various figures of a mascot character that looks just like Tontoro.

name: Sally
message: 「Nom nom, roll-roll, crunch-crunch! Kahaa, so sweet and yummy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please, Prez, have one too... or rather, have fifty of them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Go right ahead. The only thing I want is this part...」
Saying so, Lolotte picks up an unopened toy packet.

name: Sally
message: 「...For a big eater like Lolo-chi... that's rare, huh? Is this what they call a big spender?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tagalong, just keep quiet and suck on your Kintaro candy.」

name: Sally
message: 「You know, no matter how much you bite into these, Kintaro's face keeps showing up--it's so cool!」

name: Synn
message: 「That takes me back. Even though the bonus toys are new, the candy itself is still the same as ever.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph, next time for sure, I will pull a winner.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic... Another dud... It's Miniskirt Tontoro...」
In Lolotte's palm sits a tiny Tontoro wearing an outfit identical to the Ryuusei Academy girls' uniform.
Curious, I checked the manufacturer on the package again and saw the name of a Rosenkreuz family affiliate.
It seems they at least got permission from Ryuusei Academy to use the design--there's a proper copyright notice. This must be Helena-san's doing.
The proof is that the lineup chart for the candy toy figures doesn't include a male student... no, a Male Student Tontoro.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hafun... Please, let me get a winner!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? It's a total dud! I got Melilottontoro, the demon-horned librarian!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't want this. Toss!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's harsh.」

name: Sally
message: 「Looks like it'd make a good talisman to ward off evil. I'll take it!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「U-Ugh... I can't buy any more after this... God, please, this time for sure...」
The Rosenkreuz family is involved in making these. If she just asked someone at home, she could get as many as she wanted...

name: Synn
message: 「You're admirable, Lolotte. Buying the snacks properly with your own allowance.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'm not admirable at all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why... something like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?」
Wait, wasn't she down because she couldn't get the figure she wanted?

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, would you try opening one for me? Maybe it'll go well if you do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, if I'm good enough.」

name: Sally
message: 「A different one from before came out!」

name: Synn
message: 「...A Tontoro wearing a tuxedo and elegantly dual-wielding pistols?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's one of the rare ones, Elegantontoro.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll give that one to you, President.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I pulled one the other day too and gave it to Jiiya as a present. He was super happy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I had a friend once... and I want to give them an Elephan-Tontoro...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, it's right here on the checklist chart♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a Tontoro shaped like a baby elephant, and it can flap its big ears to fly freely through the sky. Hmph!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah」
I nod, though more than her explanation, what bothers me is that Lolotte spoke in the past tense, saying 'had a friend.'

name: Sally
message: 「Lolo-chi, you look kinda lonely?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...I'm super happy being here with my family and the President and everyone. So I'm totally fine!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm, is that so?」

name: Sally
message: 「...Lolo-chi, look, look! Snap. No matter how much you eat, it's Kintaro Candy」

name: Sally
message: 「B-u-t, crack. If you eat it diagonally, it becomes Giant Takadanobaba!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Freebie-san...」
From inside the bushes behind Lolotte, Riesling-san staggered out.
However, instead of his usual dashing entrance, he had a hand pressed to his mouth, his shoulders trembling slightly as he turned his face away.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What the hell are you holding back a burst of laughter for? Did Flat-chest's lame-ass gag actually hit the butler's funny bone?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Baton?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave hunting down My Lady's rare items to I, Riesling Tooyama」
Riesling-san places a tiny Tontoro figure onto Lolotte's palm.

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-An Angel Tontoro...?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! That's the secret rare, no fair, no fair! Gimme, gimme!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please don't touch it. This belongs to that girl. I won't give it to you, Freebie-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you so much, Jiiya. I love you♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am deeply humbled」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Giggle... If you think it's funny too, Jiiya, you should just smile as big as you want」

name: Riesling
message: 「However...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's right, Riesling-san! If we all laugh together, we can be happy!」

name: Synn
message: 「And so--」

name: Synn
message: 「The sea breeze got cold? Ahahaha, the cold one is my girlfriend!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. I shall now return to Class-A guard deployment. Excuse me」

name: Sally
message: 「Munch munch, delicious--♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san, I think I'll eat some candy too after all. Lick~」
